text.p: French air cargo handling services company, France Handling, said it recorded a 1996 turnover of 300 million francs, compared to 291 million francs in 1995.
Cargo tonnage handled by France Handling totalled 306,000 tonnes, up five percent on the previous year's levels, a company official confirmed.
France Handling provides air cargo handling services to around 70 airlines based at Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports.
It also operates a daily trucking service to the Paris airports from France's main regional gateways - Marseille, Bordeaux, Toulouse, Lyon, Mulhouse, Nantes, Lille
France Handling's principal shareholders are Swiss freight distribution giant, Danzas and the Paris airports authority, Aeroports de Paris. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
